clue.text: Four in fresh search for data

indicators.note: in tells us the four goes inside the reworked letters of search
fresh suggests a new version, so the letters of search are rearranged

parts.note: IV is four in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Someone starts a new hunt for information, four times over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Four' is read as a Roman numeral. 'fresh' turns the search letters into ARCHES, and 'in' sets the numeral after its fourth letter; 'for' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Archives are stored records, a body of documents and information kept for reference.

clue.text: It is included in a doctor's rounds

indicators.note: is included in says the first word goes inside the phrase that follows it

parts.note: MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's qualification; the possessive adds S
taken as written

explanation.surface: A physician's ward rounds take in something unspecified.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is included in' puts IT between A+MB and S. MB (Bachelor of Medicine) is a standard crossword doctor.
explanation.definitionFit: Ambits are the circuits or bounds of something, so rounds in the sense of a compass or range.

clue.text: Restrict study on stress

indicators.note: in a down clue on means the first piece sits on top of the second

parts.note: to con is an old word meaning to study or learn
strain is pressure or stress

explanation.surface: Limit how much you study under pressure.
explanation.definitionFit: To constrain is to hold back or limit, a straightforward synonym of restrict.

clue.text: Publication for children

definitions.meaning: offspring or descendants, as legal language puts it

explanation.definitionFit: Issue means both one number of a periodical and, formally, a person's offspring.

clue.text: Improved and repaired under direction

indicators.note: in a down clue under puts the repair word below the compass point

parts.note: E, east, is a compass direction
mended means repaired

explanation.surface: Something was fixed and made better on instruction.
explanation.definitionFit: Emended means corrected or improved, usually of a text, by making alterations.

clue.text: Cause of breathing difficulty found? Hats off to mother!

indicators.note: off suggests something gone wrong, so the letters of hats are scrambled

parts.note: ma is an informal word for mother

explanation.surface: Someone salutes their mother by raising their hat, having found what makes breathing hard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' rearranges HATS to ASTH. 'Hats off' looks like a salute but gives the anagram; 'found?' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Asthma is a respiratory condition whose attacks make it hard to breathe.

clue.text: Period when one is not well off

definitions.text: Period when one is not well off

parts.words: Period when one is not well off
parts.note: not well off reads as being poor, but here it means being ill and off work

explanation.surface: A spell of poverty.
explanation.definitionFit: Sick leave is time away from work allowed because of illness.

clue.text: Convenient for the borders of Hungary

definitions.text: Convenient for the borders of Hungary

parts.words: Convenient for the borders of Hungary
parts.note: the borders of the word Hungary are its first and last letters, which written out with the conjunction between them give a word for convenient

explanation.surface: Hungary's frontiers are well placed.
explanation.walkthrough: The edges of 'Hungary' are its first letter and last letter; say them with the word for joining between them and you have a synonym of 'Convenient'.
explanation.definitionFit: Handy means conveniently placed or useful.

clue.text: Dice can't change your bad luck

indicators.note: change signals that the letters of dice and can't are reordered

explanation.surface: A gambler is told rolling differently won't cure their misfortune.
explanation.walkthrough: 'change' rearranges DICE + CANT; 'your' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An accident is a mishap, a piece of misfortune that happens unexpectedly.

clue.text: Is jesting about providing support at hand on flight

indicators.note: about places the jesting word around the first word

parts.note: banter is jesting talk
taken as written

explanation.surface: Joking around helps someone in a tight spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' wraps the jesting word around 'Is'. 'flight' means a flight of stairs, not air travel, and 'providing' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A banister is the handrail on a staircase, held for support while climbing.

clue.text: Such a railway may make a fair profit

definitions.text: Such a railway may make a fair profit

parts.words: Such a railway may make a fair profit
parts.note: fair seems to mean reasonable, but it is a funfair where this kind of ride runs

explanation.surface: A rail line expected to earn a decent return.
explanation.walkthrough: A scenic railway is a British name for a fairground roller coaster.
explanation.definitionFit: A scenic railway is a miniature fairground railway or roller coaster through artificial scenery.

clue.text: Second hand employed

definitions.meaning: second-hand goods have had a previous owner

explanation.definitionFit: Used means both pre-owned and put into service.

clue.text: The name is right

definitions.meaning: the heading or label something is known by

explanation.definitionFit: A title is the name of a work and also a legal right of ownership.

clue.text: Note is performed as shown

parts.note: D is a note of the musical scale
taken as written
played means performed

explanation.surface: A musical note is played as written.
explanation.definitionFit: Displayed means exhibited or shown.

clue.text: With grounds for having ended the journey by air

definitions.text: having ended the journey by air

explanation.surface: A landowner arrives by plane.
explanation.definitionFit: Landed describes property-owning families and also a flight that has come down to earth.

clue.text: Decide to stop on my own

parts.note: to deter is to prevent or stop
mine means belonging to me

explanation.surface: Someone resolves to halt their own plans.
explanation.definitionFit: To determine is to settle or resolve, a synonym of decide.

clue.text: Departed on vessel, showing no emotion

indicators.note: on joins the two pieces, the first followed by the second

parts.note: the departed are the dead
a pan is a cooking vessel

explanation.surface: Someone left aboard a ship without any feeling.
explanation.definitionFit: A deadpan expression is blank and impassive, showing no feeling.

clue.text: I try penal reform — others subscribe to it

indicators.note: reform suggests reshaping, so the letters of I try penal are rearranged

explanation.surface: A politician calls for changes to sentencing while colleagues sign up.
explanation.definitionFit: A party line is the official policy of a political party that members are expected to support.

clue.text: Notice work getting into shape for a takeover

parts.note: an ad is a notice in a newspaper
op, short for opus, is a work

indicators.note: shape is used as a verb meaning form, so the letters are moulded anew

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A business gets ready to acquire another after a warning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shape' rearranges AD + OP + INTO; 'getting' and 'for' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Adoption is the act of taking something over as one's own, such as a policy or child.

clue.text: Gave a fellow the wrong date

parts.note: a don is a university fellow

indicators.note: wrong signals that the date's letters are put in a different order

explanation.surface: Someone told a college man the incorrect day.
explanation.definitionFit: Donated means gave as a gift.

clue.text: Platform is said to be unstable

indicators.note: unstable suggests letters falling into a new order

explanation.surface: A stage is rumoured to be wobbly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be unstable' rearranges SAID; 'is' is a link, and 'said' looks like a sound signal but is fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: A dais is a raised platform at one end of a hall.

clue.text: Author to have a shot at verse

parts.note: Edgar Allan Poe was an American author
to try is to have a shot

explanation.surface: A writer attempts some poems.
explanation.definitionFit: Poetry is literary writing in verse.

clue.text: An empty new settlement

indicators.note: new suggests a fresh arrangement of the letters of an empty

explanation.surface: A recently built village stands deserted.
explanation.definitionFit: A payment settles a debt, so it is a settlement of an account.

clue.text: It checks the growth of population

definitions.text: It checks the growth of population

parts.words: It checks the growth of population
parts.note: checks seems to mean restrains, but it means counts and examines the numbers

explanation.surface: Something that curbs population growth.
explanation.definitionFit: A census is an official count of the people in a country.

clue.text: Such a suit may make Ian pretty upset

indicators.note: upset implies tipping over, so the letters of Ian pretty are disordered

explanation.surface: A fatherhood lawsuit might distress a good-looking Ian.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' rearranges IAN PRETTY; 'may make' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A paternity suit is a legal action to establish who a child's father is.

clue.text: Old woman tickled to death?

definitions.meaning: a disparaging name for an older woman
fish of this kind are caught by tickling with the hands

explanation.definitionFit: Trout is slang for an unpleasant older woman, and a fish that can be caught by tickling.

clue.text: The herb season, we hear

indicators.note: we hear tells us the word for season is heard, not written

parts.note: time can mean season, as in harvest time

explanation.surface: A herb in season, as reported.
explanation.definitionFit: Thyme is an aromatic herb used in cooking.

clue.text: Teacher's expression of disgust over our skipping university

indicators.note: in a down clue over places the first piece above the second

parts.note: tut is a sound of disapproval

indicators.note: skipping means leaving out the letter that follows

parts.note: taken as written before the deletion

explanation.surface: A teacher tuts at us for missing college.
explanation.walkthrough: 'skipping' takes U from OUR to leave OR. The definition is 'Teacher' with 's for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: A tutor is a private teacher or one who guides students.

clue.text: Architectural style about right? That's sarcastic!

indicators.note: about wraps the architectural style around the letter for right

parts.note: Ionic is a classical order of architecture

explanation.surface: Someone mocks a building's style as correct.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts R inside IONIC; 'That's' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Ironic speech says the opposite of what is meant, close to sarcastic mockery.

clue.text: Drop-outs vandalise bank site

indicators.note: vandalise implies wrecking, so the letters of bank site are smashed and rebuilt

explanation.surface: Dropouts deface a bank's premises.
explanation.definitionFit: Beatniks were the 1950s and 60s counterculture youth who rejected conventional society.

clue.text: In June the rates will be lower

indicators.note: In says the answer is found inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: Interest rates will fall at the start of summer.
explanation.definitionFit: Nether is an old word meaning lower or under, as in nether regions.

clue.text: Streaks wildly round mid-afternoon — like this?

definitions.text: Streaks wildly round mid-afternoon — like this?

indicators.note: round puts the jumbled letters around the central letter
wildly signals the letters of streaks are thrown about

parts.note: the middle letter of afternoon is R

explanation.surface: A streaker dashes about in broad daylight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wildly' rearranges STREAKS to STAKERS, and 'round' puts it around R. A streaker runs naked, as the whole clue hints.
explanation.definitionFit: Starkers is British slang for completely naked, as streakers are.
